description: Prestaged production hooks for EPLUS Cowork deployment. Each wiring uses the polyglot shell-form pattern proven in hook-testing-plugin field testing (2026-08-19/20): the .ps1 half runs on Windows hosts (where hooks execute in Cowork Chat), the .sh half on POSIX surfaces, each no-ops on the other's platform, and the trailing `exit 0` is valid in every shell Claude Code routes to.
